US indicts Venezuela's Maduro and wife on torture charges

The United States has indicted former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife on charges related to an alleged torture conspiracy. The indictment, unsealed on an unspecified date, accuses the couple of involvement in the torture of Americans. Specific allegations include electric shocks and beatings. Maduro was already facing potential life imprisonment in the U.S. on other charges.
